🏆 Event Details

• Time: 3:00PM
• Entry Fee: $25 (includes 1 Conflagrant Sentinel Stamped • Promo, 2 DTR booster packs, and 1 EVP)

• Top 8: 1 DTR Booster Pack
• Top 4: 2 EVP
• Winner: 3 EVP + Lily, Marine Castellan Store Champion Playmat + Surveil the Winds CPR

🍀 Lucky Draw
• 1x Starter Deck (3 winners)
• 3x DTR Booster Packs (2 winners)

The event is capped at 32 pax. This means that all participants will receive the Conflagrant Sentinel Promo.
